C-OPENCODE-V2-NATIVE.IntentSummary: Preserve the complete v1.7.0 product while replacing host boundaries with native OpenCode 2.0.18 contracts; implement ten coarse tasks with two independent checkpoints and real-host acceptance.

PlanningNotes.Note: The owner explicitly delegated all stages in msg_0e377356e001SAwggxGxA4Jp1p. Stage approvals use recorded authority v2-native-owner-autonomy, run-c565cdbac5dc6ab5; they are controller-delegated, not fabricated later user messages. Select parallel-safe mode under that authority, only after GRACE preflight and exact-scope disjointness checks.

Fresh baseline: frozen dependency install, complete check (1698 tests/103 files, 7740 expectations, 12.45 seconds for tests), GRACE lint/status without errors. Budget ordinary leaf gates using measured local runtime; the slower isolated-host suite is a separate mandatory acceptance tier, not a nested GRACE command.

Architecture: src/runtime owns a small typed native Context service, authenticated same-instance client, resource permission service, persistent snapshot store and real-model variant materialization. Plugins consume native shapes or small domain interfaces, never a V1 facade. Root aggregation and standalone native subpaths share lifecycle-safe runtime acquisition. Temporary unported baseline sources/dependencies are removed by T-009, not exposed through dual runtime dispatch.

Snapshot identity is family-root plus persisted capture content. Stage before awaited admission, validate host lineage, persist before publish, preserve explicit model selection, replay capture-qualified variants on model transforms, and gate every actual request kind. Native config.updated updates candidates for unbound work without forced location reload. Auxiliary title/Guardian generation uses bound children.

Native tool schemas and results must match the pinned host. Workflow domain services remain host-independent; native subagent mapping, background completion, malformed-result continuation and cancellation evidence belong to the host boundary. Never remove old domain regression assertions merely to obtain a green suite.

Ownership is exact-file registered before dispatch. T-004 and T-005 may run together; after midpoint, T-006 and T-007 may run together, and T-008 follows the telemetry/TUI data contract. New files within this approved migration boundary require a recorded task amendment before worker writes. Shared edits are serialized; reviewers never edit.

Checkpoint MID covers T-001 through T-005 and assigns one independent code reviewer to architecture, invariants and host evidence. Checkpoint FINAL covers all ten tasks and assigns one independent spec reviewer to complete parity and current evidence. No automatic per-attempt reviewer pair. Failed findings route to bounded worker rework and scoped re-review without waiving either checkpoint.

Controller acceptance after every task reads material changed code and fresh evidence. Durable projections are applied centrally by one T-010 worker, after observed implementation; contracts/maps/summaries are maintained by each owning worker. No lifecycle status is used for transient progress.

Parity acceptance includes all eleven plugins, all CLI/setup/config surfaces, managed prompts/skills, full /context and its indicators, direct/synthetic/auxiliary/background work, child/fork/worktree lineage, restart/replay, explicit choices, denied permissions, interrupted workers, split-placeholder restoration and actual payload sent by captured model variants. Paid provider effectiveness is explicitly unverified.

T-001.Title: Native runtime foundation and authenticated client/permission services

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-01/04: Add pinned dependencies and native src/runtime context/client/permissions/types modules with lifecycle cleanup and documented consumer interfaces. Discover only the already-running service, authenticate from native registration, challenge its plugin instance, and enforce resource permissions before effects. Preserve package version.

Counterexamples: wrong service/location/instance, missing registration, denied or interrupted permission, duplicate runtime acquisition and disposal all fail safely without ensure/stop or leaked credentials.

T-002.Title: Persistent family snapshots and native model-role materialization

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-02/03/04/10: Implement runtime snapshot store, capture/lineage/admission engine, real-model variant transforms and native model-roles plugin. Expose snapshot-bound configuration, model selection and auxiliary generation to all later plugins. Preserve raw role intent and explicit choice provenance through config watcher events.

Exercise empty tab versus first work, failed persistence/admission rollback, competing explicit switch, direct generate/synthetic, children/forks/worktree moves, replay after restart, capture-qualified variant payload differences, and snapshot-bound title bypass. Do not use stateless generate or forced location reload.

T-003.Title: Versioned parity inventory and isolated real-host core harness

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-11: Add scripts/e2e-v2 runner, owned isolated fixture/provider and parity matrix. Exercise the packed native model-role subpath and real runtime, not a separate simulated implementation. Pin binary/source hashes, isolate HOME/XDG/environment, reject non-loopback dispatch, preserve exact PID ownership and write observed machine-readable evidence.

Reproduce the established core seam cases against current package code: awaited admission, synthetic work, explicit choice, registry replay and payload sentinel, lineage/worktree, authenticated resource permissions, title and response hooks. Distinguish core-only from complete-product acceptance.

T-004.Title: Native workflow integration, continuation and cancellation recovery

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-05: Port native subagent launch/result/event/message/authorization contracts and schema registration while retaining the domain state machine, budgets, persistence and review obligations. Support foreground/background completion and bounded same-child continuation with native prompt/wait/message evidence.

Cancelled resumed attempts survive hydration as in-flight and consumed. Explicit recovery atomically settles only with root Task cancelled, child MessageAbortedError and quiescence evidence; preserve historical completion timestamps. Unknown/running/spoofed outcomes never clear a live attempt. Failure to persist publishes neither settlement nor authority.

T-005.Title: Native safety, editing, web and spec-guard boundaries

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-04/06: Port Guardian, secrets redaction, hashline/edit routing, web tools and spec guard with native schemas/results and snapshot policies. Keep pure validators/services and their regressions. Guardian uses family-bound auxiliary inference and native permission events; denied permissions block network/filesystem effects.

Verify split-placeholder SSE/WS restoration, opaque-frame preservation, all request kinds, tool restoration, edit-tool visibility/execution enforcement, stale anchors, strict web defaults/errors and scoped spec gating. Disabled plugins and cleanup retain intended behavior.

Verification.Command: bun test src/plugins/guardian.integration.test.ts src/plugins/hashline-edit.integration.test.ts src/plugins/web-tools.integration.test.ts src/plugins/secrets-redaction src/plugins/spec-guard

T-006.Title: Native system context, analytics, history compaction and peak-hours

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-07: Port remaining four plugins using native session/context/tool/event data and snapshot policy. Preserve primary/subagent distinctions, provider-reported usage/cache accounting, selected-agent attribution, post-compaction recent tool history, peak-hour grace/exemptions and safe cleanup.

Negative controls prove disabled effects disappear, hard peak denial precedes requests without killing existing work, opaque or missing usage does not become fabricated data, and compaction preserves the recent protected window.

T-007.Title: Native CLI/config lifecycle, canonical presets and managed assets

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-09/10: Migrate all install/sync/init/launch/status/doctor/config/plugin/upgrade surfaces to native host version/schema/registration contracts; retain conservative scope and JSONC edits. Change managed content/tool references to native subagent semantics, not cosmetic V1 renaming. Remove live vv-kimi surfaces, retain user-owned unrelated data and prescribed residual provider patches; publish MiMo thinking correctly without PDF.

Test fresh and repeated setup, global/project/env precedence, invalid config, exact unsupported host versions, canonical preset/variant materialization, role references and user overrides, completions and every shipped skill/agent loader.

Verification.Command: bun test src/commands src/lib/opencode.test.ts src/lib/managed-agents.test.ts src/lib/managed-skills.test.ts src/lib/vvoc-config.test.ts src/lib/model-roles.test.ts

T-008.Title: Complete native V2 TUI and context inspector

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-08: Port the complete TUI, not a stub: Overview/Tools/MCP collection and rendering, provider/model usage, honest estimates, compaction cutoff, tabs/keyboard/scroll/resize, indicators/footer/banner, toggles and disposal. Derive data from native client/TUI contracts.
Use host-shaped unit fixtures and real PTY acceptance for navigation, narrow window, reopen and error states; unavailable information remains explicitly unknown rather than invented or always empty.

T-009.Title: Native package assembly and full real-host parity acceptance

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-01/11/12: Assemble root and all standalone native exports, remove all V1 SDK/dependencies and obsolete host fixtures, update strict tool-contract census and generated reference, retain every domain regression. Complete harness coverage against the installed packed root and TUI for every parity row; no fixtures can substitute for the plugin being accepted.

Check real workflow launch/results/recovery, safety before effects, payload/model policies, session-family/restart behavior and TUI. Negative controls must detect missing hooks or no-op effects. Build/pack/check/release consistency pass without bumping the package.

T-010.Title: Central durable reconciliation and final independently reviewed delivery

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-12: Synchronize README/AGENTS and all affected GRACE context, graph and verification entries, including M-NATIVE-RUNTIME and M-E2E-V2-HARNESS, actual dependencies/flows/commands and honest evidence limits. Preserve immutable archives and main history. Final independent review covers complete current implementation and parity evidence.

Controller runs selected target/final gates externally after durable reconciliation and accepts only observed passing evidence. Apply/archive lifecycle only under the owner's recorded delegation, never as transient run state. Report exact residual uncertainty; no push or publication.
